translations.web: Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
translations.bsb: Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
translations.kjv: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
translations.asv: Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
